verdict: Ads are running and generating interest, but leads aren't landing in your system.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $1,015.39 was spent on Google Ads and Google recorded 11 conversions — but none of those contacts are appearing in your CRM, meaning your true cost per lead and pipeline cannot be measured right now. A disconnect between Google's tracking and your contact system is the confirmed cause, and reconnecting that handoff is the immediate priority this week. Separately, Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply in the last several days, which we're monitoring closely. Several planned milestones — including the booking automation, Homer Glen branch page, and LSA heating toggle — are also running behind schedule, and we're working to clear those before the fall heating season opens in October.
